input.answer:
British Columbia had more people on July 1, 2026, according to StatCan's quarterly population estimates (table 17-10-0009, reference period 2026-07, which is the July 1 estimate).

- British Columbia: 5,710,598
- Alberta: 5,101,050

The difference is 5,710,598 − 5,101,050 = 609,548 people in BC's favour.

Source: https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=1710000901
